{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicate_count}")

# Check if any sample_seq is greater than 1 for the same patient
max_sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {max_sample_seq_per_patient.describe()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline_count}")

# Check for association between arm and severity
arm_severity_crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print("Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(arm_severity_crosstab)

# Check the actual unique patient count before deduplication
unique_patients_before = df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f"Unique patient_id count before deduplication: {unique_patients_before}")"}
